session: This round was opened by the SESSION as M0-a-05's HARDENING ROUND S15 (J237 (2): the M0 hardening phase's fix rounds, batched per owning item; J238: M0 is the bedrock — the default for an M0 row is FIX with an exact precaution and a pin; J567: the bar is an independent closing check's PASS on the evidence), on the rows J757 routes to this item (RQ2's code consequence, rulings-hardening-1.md §2, REPORTED at its S9 for want of the registry row and the strip — both now built by legs 1 and 2): the write of `(shape, chain)` at the chain's commit, the extended dissolvable check, RQ2's second pin (pass4), the role kept from callers, and the round's content shift. Each 'failing line' below is one such row — an open queue row routed to this item (docs/M0-FIX-QUEUE.md) or a row the item's latest closing check wrote into its notes file; its evidence names the SOURCE you MUST read whole before fixing; the fix shape and the pin are the re-triage's reading, binding unless the source or the code shows it wrong — then say so in your notes and do what the finding needs. THE RULES OF A HARDENING ROUND: (1) inside the item's owns and nowhere else — the seven files plat/packages/kernel/src/insert/{stretch,crossings,snapRound,wedge,rewalk,insertChain,index}.ts and the folder plat/packages/kernel/test/insert/step3-5/ (M0-work.json); THIS LEG HAS NO CROSS-ITEM SCOPE — the dissolvable check RQ2 and J757 name is dissolvableProblems in this item's own test/insert/step3-5/support.ts (M0-a-14's invariants/ hold none); a row that needs another item's file is REPORTED, not built; (2) every row gets a PIN (a test that is red without the fix; your mutant table shows each pin killing its mutant) unless the row is comment-only or asks for a choices row — then the text is the deliverable; (3) BEHAVIOUR: a hardening fix may move output where a defect is fixed — a DECLARED shift, stated in your choices row with the before and after (digests and goldens re-recorded in the same round, named), never silent; where a row offers alternatives, take the one the design's text supports and say which; a change of an operation's or stage's CONTRACT (its design-level behaviour, a record or file format, an exported API) is NOT yours — report it as a note for the session's ruling and leave the row at REPORTED; (4) J264 / N-58: the refusal census of the item's registered families before and after the round, never rising (a row whose fix makes a lawful input succeed lowers it and says so); (5) API frozen (J263 Q1): no export of a folder index or the barrel added, removed or renamed unless a row explicitly asks for one — then the index change is the row's and stated; message texts pinned verbatim where a row changes one (J263 Q6); (6) the gates, NEAR and RELATED@1000 as the brief above says, at W=1; (7) the item's notes file gains a section 'Hardening round S15' with the row-by-row outcome (fixed / pinned / reported, each with its evidence and mutant), and the round's choices row names every row it closes. The CLOSING CHECKER confirms every row's outcome with its own evidence (re-reading the source note or queue row), re-kills every pin's mutant, re-measures the refusal census, and judges new findings by the blocker rule only; a row left REPORTED with a stated contract reason is not a failing line. THIS IS LEG 3 OF A MERGED ROUND (the MERGED-ROUND RULE, J443): M0-a-02 S4 → M0-a-06 S10 → M0-a-05 S15, in that order, on ONE tree and ONE branch, no reset between, each leg with its own build, closing check, LANDED line and record; a leg launches only when the leg before it returned ok with check.verdict pass (each builds on the one before). RULINGS BINDING (read each by its own grep, never the 1.3 MB file whole: grep '^| J757 ' docs/PROGRESS.md): J757 — RL4: the kernel-internal vertex role `shape` enters M0 as ONE step, the registry row with the version raised (leg 1), the strip of a removed chain's `shape` rows (leg 2), the write at the landing with its register kind and the dissolvable check (leg 3); R10: the stale stamp after compactSlots / load is closed by the restore GENERATION (compactSlots and load move it; no chunk-header change), built and pinned in leg 2; J358 / N-61 (2) and plat/docs/build/checks/rulings-hardening-1.md §2 (RQ2, read WHOLE); J238 (1)–(3), J264, J290 / N-58; J631 (2) (a) — the round changes a persisted format and took its adversarial review at this spec.
